active_model.sql: SELECT m.* FROM active_model a JOIN model_version m USING(model_version_id)

projection_envelope.sql: SELECT envelope_json FROM projection_set WHERE projection_set_id=?

series_CN_BOND_CORE_000012.sql: SELECT * FROM source_claim WHERE metric_id=? AND definition_version=? AND available_at IS NOT NULL AND julianday(available_at)<=julianday(?) ORDER BY period_end,observation_id,julianday(available_at),claim_id

coverage_CN_BOND_CORE_000012.sql: SELECT metric_id,definition_version,COUNT(*) AS claim_vintages,COUNT(DISTINCT period_end) AS distinct_business_dates,MIN(period_end) AS first_business_date,MAX(period_end) AS latest_business_date,MIN(available_at) AS first_system_available,MAX(available_at) AS last_system_available FROM source_claim WHERE metric_id=? AND definition_version=? GROUP BY metric_id,definition_version
